explanation: The theorem says that the scalar action of a section of the structure sheaf on a section of an 𝒪_X-module, computed in the presheaf-of-modules fibre, agrees with the Γ(X,U)-module structure on Γ(P,U). It is proved by `rfl`, so it only restates how the library's own coercion unfolds the Module instance. In Mathlib, `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean` defines the instance `Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U)` (line 94) as `(M.val.obj (.op U)).isModule`. It also has `Scheme.Modules.smul_apply`, `map_smul` and `Hom.app_smul`. None of these is this statement. `smul_apply` is about the `End`-valued `smul` map. `map_smul` is about restriction maps. `Hom.app_smul` is about module homomorphisms. I found no lemma that restates the instance definition in this form.
